N Chandrasekaran to step down as Tata Sons chairman in February 2027

N Chandrasekaran will step down as the chairman of Tata Sons in February 2027, after completing his second five-year term. He will serve out his current term, which ends then. Chandrasekaran has led the conglomerate for nine years, overseeing its growth into a $400 billion empire. His tenure has been marked by significant developments, including a focus on technology, artificial intelligence, and energy transition. The announcement of his departure led to a market capitalization drop of ₹45,000 crore across Tata stocks, with Tata Consultancy Services experiencing the sharpest decline.
